title: cerastium riaei subsp. lamottei
intro: Cerastium riaei subsp. lamottei, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of Cerastium riaei, a species of annual or biennial plants in the family Caryophyllaceae. The health benefits associated with Cerastium riaei subsp. lamottei include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress in the body.
